blocks.title: A program in the Spanish profile

runs.text: This specification can be read with either profile. Programs are written once and the engine translates them; that is why, in the English edition, quoted texts stay in Spanish.
The interface language and the syntax profile are different things. You can read the specification in English with programs in the Spanish profile, or the other way round.
There is a single place where the profile changes what you see when running: writing a boolean value. In the Spanish profile
is written and in the English profile
. Everything else, numbers included, is written the same way.

points.text: There are two official profiles: Spanish and English.
They have the same rules; only the words change.
The engine translates between them without touching names, texts or comments.
Boolean values are written with the profile's vocabulary.
